statement_conversions.statement_name: SelectAuthorsByHireYear - Authors Hired in Specific Year with Age Calculation
statement_conversions.original_sql: SELECT BusinessEntityID, FORMAT(ModifiedDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS FormattedModifiedDate, DATEDIFF(YEAR, BirthDate, GETDATE()) AS Age FROM bobsbookstore_dbo.author WHERE DATEPART(YEAR, HireDate) = @HireDate;

statement_conversions.converted_sql: SELECT businessentityid, TO_CHAR(modifieddate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS formattedmodifieddate, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, birthdate)) AS age FROM bobsbookstore_dbo.author WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hiredate) = @HireDate;
statement_conversions.manual_conversion_notes: Most complex statement requiring multiple function conversions: FORMAT() to TO_CHAR() with PostgreSQL pattern format, DATEDIFF(YEAR) to EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE()), GETDATE() to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DATEPART(YEAR) to EXTRACT(YEAR FROM). Column names lowercase per PostgreSQL conventions.
